approved_design.scope: Fixed authorized ds004408 v1.0.8, no fitting or model selection on new data

required_before_prediction: Explicit equal-block person Pearson aggregation, seed average, equal-clip secondary and mechanical target/mask rules
Sign-flip statistic abs(mean(person differences)), all 2^n signs, inclusive ties tolerance1e-15; null sign-exchangeability/symmetry assumption; no causal or distribution-free claim
Bootstrap quantiles [.0125,.9875] as two-comparison Bonferroni family95 approximate intervals, Holm2 p separately
Source study/language/story/available audio identity metadata comparison and unverified broad XLSR pretraining exposure disclosure
Pin actual adapter/library source, original TRAIN units/norm, frozen model/readout coefficients and actual final data mask before inference

actual_acquisition_review.source_read: Entire v1/v2 headers, preflight v1/v2 and Range transport code read; current audio/canary acquisition not yet complete

statistical_reference.actually_read: Paired samples null/2^n sample swaps and one-sample sign flips; finite-precision ties warning. This supports documenting permutation assumptions and tie handling, not the biological independence of this dataset.
statistical_reference.note: Custom prespecified absolute-mean enumeration need not silently adopt SciPy default two-sided or tolerance conventions.

interpretation_limits: At most19 independent people, not57 seed-person observations or380 independent recordings
Conditional on one shared narrative/speaker, not multiple independent story replication
Template montage assumption and absent hardware synchronization evidence remain limitations
F single-window degeneracy and FP32-vs-FP64 stability must be reported
Positive readout/fusion generalization would not establish a continuity mechanism, novelty or publication readiness
